The first identifies the place value of each digit in a four-digit number; the second explains subtraction with or without borrowing where the first term does not exceed 10,000 (its LCs split 'with borrowing' and 'without borrowing'). Same-rank direction is therefore justified from the place-value knowledge objective to the subtraction-with-borrowing objective, not the reverse.
